reasons: Preferred level is complete: the operator flip makes clear that no liquidated damages and no penalty amount are payable by Customer for late payment.
Fallback is not satisfied, but that is irrelevant — the locked target is preferred and the two levels are separate bargains.
Minimality holds: only the operator and the quantum were changed within the single offending sentence; the rest of Section 7 is untouched and no new exception or boilerplate was added.

Drafting nit (rationale-level, not a deviation): the residual tail "any amount for each week the invoice remains unpaid" is a vestigial fragment; simply striking the sentence would read cleaner and avoid the odd affirmative 'shall not pay' formulation, which could be misread as barring other late-payment remedies such as contractual interest — though any such over-breadth runs in Customer's favour.
Margin comment matches the operative change and cites the playbook position concisely; no promise in the comment is doing operative work.
